sections.heading: Why a Storm Shelter is Essential for Van Alstyne Homes
sections.html:
Van Alstyne sits squarely in Tornado Alley, making it highly susceptible to severe weather, including powerful thunderstorms and tornadoes. The rapid development across southern Grayson County means more families are moving into an area where quick access to robust storm protection isn't just a convenience, it's a critical safety measure.

When a tornado warning sounds, you have only minutes, not hours, to seek shelter. Relying on interior rooms or public shelters might not provide the immediate, certified protection your family needs. A professionally installed storm shelter or safe room provides a designated, impact-tested refuge right on your property, built to withstand extreme forces as outlined by FEMA P-320 and ICC-500 standards.

Texoma Storm Shelters understands the urgency and importance of this protection. We are dedicated to equipping Van Alstyne residents with the highest quality storm shelters, ensuring you have a secure place for your loved ones during the most dangerous weather events North Texas can bring.

sections.heading: Choosing the Right Storm Shelter for Your Van Alstyne Property
sections.html:
With Van Alstyne's growth, especially in new residential developments, homeowners have several excellent options for storm protection. The best choice depends on your property's layout, foundation type, and personal preferences. Texoma Storm Shelters offers a range of designs to fit different needs.

For new construction homes with slab foundations, our garage floor shelters are an increasingly popular choice in Van Alstyne. These shelters are installed flush with your garage floor, remaining hidden until needed. If you prefer an outdoor option, underground shelters can be installed in your yard, providing discreet protection.

Alternatively, above-ground safe rooms offer robust protection and can be installed inside your garage or another suitable location. These are excellent for existing homes or properties where underground installation isn't feasible. We'll help you assess your property and choose the ideal solution.
